concept: Physiotherapy and sports rehab; a pain-area finder and booking.

shots.title: Hero
shots.prompt: Interior photograph of a bright physiotherapy studio with treatment tables, rigs and a running strip in Al Quoz, Dubai, calm, clean and welcoming, natural light, a sense of privacy and care, nobody present. Overall look: clean sports-medicine photography, daylight, 35mm; colour palette of white, cobalt, warm wood, black. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
